claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, methylprednisolone is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent; any killing would reflect weak, non-selective glucocorticoid receptor-mediated antiproliferative effects rather than a potent cytotoxic mechanism.
